title: Does the Sea Mirror the Sky?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I bring my lunch up onto the roof one day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, over here! Hello, I'm Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find Aston Machan waving at the sky.
What's she doing? I look up in
the
direction she's waving and see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is that a helicopter?
It looks like it just
flew over Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a press helicopter.
I heard from a friend
that they take photos of
Tracen Academy
from way up above.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She notices me and turns to explain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess she wanted to get into their
photos. Even if they did spot her,
though,
they might not necessarily have zoomed in
on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that didn't stop her from smiling
up at
the sky. The small chance
that they might
capture her was all she needed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My dream... is to become a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Not just any mascot. I want to be a super
mascot known all over the
world.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I want to appear everywhere, by everybody's side, and be a super mascot! No—a super ultra mascot!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The helicopter looks like it's swimming,
doesn't it? Gliding along...
Ah, the sky is
kind of like the sea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her dream is to remain in people's
memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But racing amongst all the most talented
runners, it's not going to be
easy to stand
out and make a deep, lasting impression.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the faraway sky will ever get
closer someday. Then maybe
we'd all go
there, just like the sea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gaze up at the sky with her and
wonder...
What can I do as her
trainer to make her
dream come true?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hahhh... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Here Machan goes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch her run, I think about how to
plan her training from now on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ponder what we should do and what we
must. What we want to do
and what it'll
take.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So what's most important is the mark you
leave behind. A trace that
lives on even
after you're gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her dream is so big that we'd have to win
an awful lot of races and
achieve some real
feats to make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, my lens. Who are you focusing
on right now?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The light in your eyes is orange. Rather
than the sky, please focus on
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. So about Machan, then.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, good. We have to make sure I'm
remembered just like you
remember me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There is so much life in this world. And
each living thing has its own
way of being.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to leave a mark on all of
them,
I'm going to need much
more myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks straight into my eyes, with a
look that says she's willing to
put in all the
effort it takes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I trust you'll help me get there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No more thinking, only doing. All for the
dream, all of the time, no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I vow to do everything I can to help Aston
Machan leave a deep
impression on as
many hearts as possible.
